sector_mapping.note: The strongest and best-documented of the three transmissions. 삼성전자 and SK하이닉스 are the memory makers; 한미반도체, 리노공업 and HPSP are equipment and test, which move with the same capex cycle.

Weaker and slower than semis; treat the correlation column as load-bearing. Renamed from 정유/조선 because the watchlist holds no refiner — these are shipbuilders (HD한국조선해양, 한화오션) and defence (한화에어로스페이스, LIG, 현대로템). The energy link runs through shipbuilding order books rather than through crack spreads, which is a real but indirect channel.

Risk-appetite proxy rather than a sector link. This row named RUT — the Russell 2000 *index* — until 2026-08-06. Nothing collects RUT; the US collector holds IWM, the ETF that tracks it (us_price.INDEX_ETFS). The Korean side is the watchlist's small and mid caps regardless of listing venue; 코스닥 was the old label but 두산로보틱스 and 금호타이어 are KOSPI, so the name would have been wrong.
